name: Seal Row
instructions: Lie face-down on an elevated bench with a barbell hanging below you.
Row the bar to your lower chest, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
The chest-supported position removes all momentum.
Lower to full arm extension. Strict, heavy rows for the mid-back.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate barbell pull-pattern exercise for the lats. Seal Row strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
